    Contact us

    Have a question about the checker, found a mistake in a guide, or want to make a privacy request? Send us an email.

    its.sumitpandit@gmail.com

    What to include

    • Problems with the tool: your browser, your file type, and what happened.
    • Corrections: the page address and what needs changing.
    • Privacy requests: what you would like us to do. See our Privacy Policy.
    • Copyright notices: follow the steps in our DMCA Policy.

    Please do not email your resume or other sensitive personal information unless we ask for it.
